jobs.title: Training Specialist (HOA & COA Management)
jobs.description:
Description:
**Training Specialist**

**Company:** Cusick Community Management  

**Location:** Charlotte, NC  

**Work Arrangement:** Primarily in\-office, with a minimum of three days per week. Full in\-office presence is expected during new hire onboarding weeks and major program rollouts.  

**Reports To:** President  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Salaried

**Position Summary**


Cusick Community Management is seeking an experienced and highly organized **Training Specialist** to own and lead the company's employee training, onboarding, systems education, program rollouts, and board training initiatives.


This position will play a key role in ensuring employees have the knowledge, resources, and tools necessary to be successful in their roles. The Training Specialist will oversee the new hire experience from onboarding through the ramp period, develop training materials and programs, provide systems training, and serve as a subject matter expert for key platforms including CINC, HOAce, AvidXchange, and Vonage.


The Training Specialist will also work closely with the President and Regional Directors on company\-wide initiatives and will lead the initial training and rollout of new programs, processes, and systems. This position will also be responsible for providing training to boards of directors for communities transitioning to Cusick Community Management.

**Essential Responsibilities**

### **Employee Onboarding**

* Own the new hire experience from the employee's first day through completion of the onboarding and ramp period.
* Coordinate department\-specific onboarding with department leaders and provide training directly when appropriate.
* Develop, maintain, and update onboarding plans for each position.
* Ensure training materials remain current as company processes and procedures evolve.
* Administer competency checks to ensure new hires understand their responsibilities and can effectively perform their jobs before completing onboarding.

### **Systems Training \& Expertise**

* Serve as the internal training expert and first point of escalation for CINC, HOAce, AvidXchange, and Vonage.
* Develop and maintain role\-specific training curriculums for each platform.
* Ensure employees understand how systems should be used based on their specific responsibilities.
* Maintain consistency in how systems are configured and utilized across communities and departments.
* Evaluate new system releases and features and determine their impact and applicability to Cusick.
* Lead training and adoption of applicable system updates and enhancements.
* Coordinate user setup and permissions with system owners.
* Ensure system access is properly provisioned during onboarding and revoked during employee offboarding.

### **Program Launch \& Implementation**

* Design and deliver the initial training for new programs, processes, and system changes.
* Develop training materials, presentations, job aids, and competency assessments for new initiatives.
* Work directly with the President regarding company\-wide rollout priorities and timing.
* Prepare Regional Directors and other leaders to reinforce new programs after the initial implementation.
* Monitor adoption following implementation and identify areas requiring additional training or reinforcement.
* Return to provide additional training when programs or processes are not being consistently adopted.

### **Ongoing Training \& Development**

* Develop and maintain an ongoing training plan to ensure employees remain current as systems, statutes, and company processes change.
* Maintain training materials, study guides, reference materials, and job aids across departments.
* Meet regularly with Regional Directors and department supervisors to identify training gaps and areas where employees may need additional support.
* Develop targeted training programs when a recurring issue requires structured instruction rather than one\-on\-one coaching.
* Confirm employee understanding and competency following targeted training.
* Identify recurring issues across multiple employees and escalate patterns to leadership when they may indicate a larger process or operational issue.

### **Board Training**

* Provide onboarding and training for every new board transitioning to Cusick Community Management.
* Train board members on CINC portal functionality and clarify the respective responsibilities of the board and management company.
* Maintain and update board training materials and curriculum.
* Provide boards with reference materials they can utilize following training sessions.
* Conduct annual refresher training following board elections to account for board member turnover.
* Coordinate with the Community Association Manager and Regional Director to ensure board training is tailored to the specific community.
* Maintain accurate records of which communities have completed board training and when training occurred.

### **Employee Offboarding**

* Own and coordinate the employee offboarding process in partnership with supervisors, HR, and IT.
* Complete the company's offboarding checklist, including same\-day system access revocation.
* Coordinate equipment returns and required documentation.
* Ensure departing employees acknowledge applicable confidentiality and restrictive covenant obligations.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer and account reassignment with the employee's supervisor.
* Maintain complete and accurate offboarding documentation.


Requirements:
**Qualifications \& Experience**

* 3\+ years of experience in training, learning and development, or a supervisory position with significant training responsibilities.
* Community association management experience is preferred.
* Experience with **CINC Systems** is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with AvidXchange, Vonage or comparable VoIP systems, and AI\-assisted workflow tools is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to build training programs and materials from the ground up.
* Strong ability to understand and communicate technical information across multiple departments.
* Excellent presentation and facilitation skills with both individuals and groups.
* Comfortable delivering training in person as well as virtually.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with employees, supervisors, leadership, and client\-facing audiences.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to exercise discretion and sound judgment when handling employee offboarding and performance\-related training matters.

**What Success Looks Like: Success in this position will be measured by:**

* Reduced time to productivity for new hires.
* Successful completion of employee competency checks.
* Strong adoption of new systems, programs, and processes.
* Reduction in repeat errors and escalations involving trained responsibilities.
* Completion of board training for transitioning communities within established timelines.
* Consistent annual board refresher training.
* Accurate and timely completion of employee offboarding requirements.
* Positive feedback from supervisors and Regional Directors regarding training effectiveness and responsiveness.

**About Cusick Community Management**

  

Cusick Community Management is a division of Summit Management Partners serving more than 300 communities throughout the Carolinas. The company operates from offices in **Charlotte, Rock Hill, and Raleigh** and provides community association management services to communities throughout the region.

jobs.title: Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist Position Overview

Charm Experts is seeking a senior, client\-facing **Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist** to lead the setup, implementation, training, and ongoing optimization of CharmHealth EHR accounts for medical practices.

This position requires more than general familiarity with the platform. The successful candidate will take ownership of implementations following the initial sale, assess each practice’s clinical and administrative needs, translate those requirements into an effective CharmHealth configuration, and guide the client from discovery through go\-live and post\-launch stabilization.

Our clients range from solo providers launching new practices to established, multi\-provider organizations migrating from other EHR platforms or seeking to improve their existing CharmHealth environment.

Position Type

This position will initially be structured as a part\-time independent contractor engagement, with the potential to transition into full\-time employment based on performance, client demand, and company growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead client discovery, kickoff, implementation, and workflow\-planning meetings.
* Evaluate each practice’s clinical, administrative, scheduling, billing, and patient\-engagement requirements.
* Develop tailored implementation plans, timelines, and task lists.
* Configure new and existing CharmHealth accounts, including:
* Practice, facility, provider, and staff settings
* Roles, permissions, and user access
* Appointment types, scheduling rules, and provider calendars
* Clinical workflows and encounter settings
* Custom charting and specialty\-specific clinical templates
* Intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and patient communications
* Patient portal registration and workflows
* Telehealth services
* E\-prescribing and EPCS coordination
* Laboratory and imaging integrations
* Diagnosis, procedure, medication, and laboratory preference lists
* Billing, coding, payment, and clearinghouse workflows
* Support patient\-data migration and validate the accuracy and completeness of imported records.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and communicate with CharmHealth, clearinghouses, laboratories, pharmacies, and other vendors as needed.
* Train providers, practice administrators, clinical staff, and front\-office personnel.
* Create written implementation documentation, workflow guides, and training materials.
* Manage multiple client projects, priorities, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.
* Provide go\-live support, troubleshooting, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews and recommend improvements to workflows, templates, reporting, and system utilization.
* Maintain clear, timely, and professional communication with clients throughout each engagement.
* Identify opportunities for workflow automation, API integrations, analytics, and continued account optimization.

Required Qualifications

* Five or more years of EHR implementation, configuration, onboarding, or optimization experience.
* Substantial direct, hands\-on experience with the CharmHealth EHR and practice\-management platform.
* Demonstrated ability to configure CharmHealth accounts for real\-world medical\-practice operations.
* Experience translating clinical and administrative workflows into efficient system configurations.
* Strong understanding of medical\-practice operations, including scheduling, documentation, patient intake, prescribing, laboratory workflows, billing, and revenue\-cycle processes.
* Experience developing clinical templates, intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and standardized workflows.
* Experience training clinical and nonclinical users with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Strong project\-management, organizational, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent client\-facing communication and consultative skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of projects from discovery through stabilization.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and the proper handling of protected health information.

Strongly Preferred

* Approximately five years of direct CharmHealth implementation and optimization experience.
* Experience implementing CharmHealth across multiple specialties or practice types.
* Experience working with solo providers, startup practices, telehealth organizations, and multi\-provider medical groups.
* Experience with patient\-data migration and EHR transition projects.
* Knowledge of CharmHealth billing, eClaims, clearinghouse, and revenue\-cycle workflows.
* Familiarity with CharmHealth APIs and third\-party integrations.
* Experience with workflow\-automation and analytics platforms such as Zoho, n8n, or comparable systems.
* Experience developing reusable implementation standards, checklists, training programs, and account\-optimization plans.

What Success Looks Like

The successful specialist will be able to take a new client from an initial requirements discussion to a properly configured, documented, and stable CharmHealth environment. Providers and staff should be prepared to use the system confidently at go\-live, with efficient workflows supporting patient care, practice operations, billing, compliance, and future growth.

To Apply

Please provide:

* A résumé or summary of your relevant professional experience
* A two\- to three\-minute video introducing yourself and describing your experience working with CharmHealth
* The number of years you have worked directly with CharmHealth
* Examples of CharmHealth implementations, configurations, or optimization projects you have completed
* The types and sizes of medical practices you have supported
* Examples of clinical templates, forms, workflows, integrations, or training programs you have developed
* Your availability and preferred engagement structure
* Your hourly rate or compensation requirements

Pay: $67,964\.52 \- $81,849\.74 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

  

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP\&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at **insightsoftware.com.**

**Job Description:**

**About Us**
============

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP\&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com .


**Job Summary**
===============

The Senior Consultant, Equity Administration \& Financial Reconciliation is a highly skilled, detail\-oriented equity and financial reporting professional within insightsoftware’s Professional Services organization. This role is crucial to ensuring the accurate reconciliation of both financial reporting data for equity compensation and administrative equity data as customers migrate from their current equity management platform to the NextGen platform.


On the financial side, you will own the reconciliation of ASC 718 stock compensation expense, corporate tax, disclosures, and ASC 260 diluted EPS. On the administrative side, you will reconcile participant\- and grant\-level equity data — balances, lifecycle events, and transaction history — between the legacy platform and NextGen. Across both, you will develop and deliver comparison reports, analyze discrepancies, and produce comprehensive reconciliation documentation. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role for someone who takes initiative, thinks critically, and operates effectively across systems and teams with minimal oversight. You will be a senior point of contact on assigned workstreams, partner directly with customer stakeholders, and lead by example — mentoring more junior contributors and reliably delivering the most complex, high\-stakes work.


**What You’ll Do**
==================

**Financial Reconciliation**
----------------------------

* Reconcile equity compensation financial reporting results between the customer’s prior results and NextGen, spanning ASC 718 stock compensation expense, corporate and deferred tax, disclosures, and ASC 260 diluted EPS.
* Develop and deliver comparison reports for each reconciliation cycle, including summary and detailed analysis of differences.
* Analyze comparison reports to identify and quantify calculation differences, determine root causes, and recommend resolutions.
* Provide clear reconciliation documentation that helps customers understand the differences, if any, between NextGen’s calculations and their previous methods.
* Apply a working knowledge of how fair values, accounting setup selections, and migrated data drive these outputs — other teams perform configuration and data loading — so differences can be explained and resolved.

**Administrative Reconciliation**
---------------------------------

* Reconcile participant\- and grant\-level equity data — grants, vesting schedules, exercises, releases, cancellations, forfeitures, and outstanding/exercisable balances — between the legacy platform and NextGen.
* Validate share balances and grant lifecycle events to confirm transaction history migrated completely and accurately.
* Reconcile ESPP enrollment, contribution, and purchase data, and confirm participant demographic, tax, and account information transferred correctly.
* Identify, quantify, and document administrative discrepancies and deltas, performing root\-cause analysis and driving items to resolution.
* Produce administrative reconciliation comparison reports and maintain follow\-up trackers of open items through closure.
* Partner with the financial reconciliation workstream to ensure administrative data ties back to expense, tax, disclosure, and EPS results.

**Cross\-Functional Dependencies \& Systems Thinking**
------------------------------------------------------

* Understand how the work of adjacent teams flows together — the team loading customer data, the product team building and evolving the NextGen platform, and the administrative and financial reconciliation workstreams — and how each affects your deliverables.
* Anticipate how data loading, system configuration, and platform changes impact reconciliation results and report accuracy, and coordinate proactively to unblock and align.
* Validate migrated and loaded data against expected results, surface discrepancies to the responsible team, and confirm fixes flow through correctly — without owning the loading or configuration itself.
* Document mapping logic, exceptions, and resolution steps to maintain a clear, auditable trail across teams.

**Client Engagement \& Collaboration**
--------------------------------------

* Serve as a senior point of contact for customer stakeholders on assigned equity and reconciliation workstreams.
* Ensure deliverables meet defined SLAs and quality standards; proactively surface risks before they become issues.
* Anticipate how adjacent teams’ work affects your deliverables, and coordinate across cross\-functional teams to unblock and align.
* Lead customer conversations and follow up with clear, actionable plans.
* Mentor and support more junior team members, reinforcing standards of accuracy and accountability.

**Job Requirements**
====================

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

**Experience**
--------------

* Minimum of five years of experience in financial accounting, with a focus on equity compensation management and reconciliation.
* Strong working knowledge of ASC 718 expense reporting, ASC 260 diluted EPS, corporate tax, and disclosure concepts, with the ability to apply them to reconciliations and report building (other teams own system configuration and data loading).
* Experience with administrative/participant\-level equity reconciliation and equity\-related disclosures and year\-end tax reporting (W\-2 inserts, Forms 3921 and 3922\).
* Experience with equity management systems is desirable.
* Experience with data migration, mapping, and validation across financial and equity administration systems.

**Technical Proficiency**
-------------------------

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other financial software.
* Familiarity with equity management platforms and financial accounting systems.

**Skills \& Attributes**
========================

* **Critical Thinking \& Problem Solving:** breaks down complex problems, reasons through ambiguity, and arrives at sound, defensible conclusions.
* **Initiative \& Strong Ownership:** takes responsibility for outcomes end to end and drives work forward without needing to be managed.
* **Reconciliation Expertise:** skilled at both financial and administrative reconciliation, including discrepancy/delta identification and resolution.
* **Equity Compensation Knowledge:** solid grasp of equity compensation financial reporting and administration.
* **Data Migration, Mapping \& Validation:** able to move, map, and validate data accurately across systems.
* **Technical Expertise:** uses DB querying/SQL, report generation, data analysis, and automation to work effectively. Leverages technology efficiently without being hand\-held.
* **Cross\-Team Dependency Awareness:** understands how adjacent teams’ work impacts their own and leverages it to anticipate, unblock, and align.
* **Systems\-Level Thinking:** connects the dots across teams to see how upstream and downstream work affects deliverables, and acts on it.
* **Process Documentation \& Tracking:** creates clear process documentation and SOPs, and maintains efficient, reliable tracking of work.
* **Clear Communication:** strong written and verbal communication, including status reporting, escalations, and meeting follow\-ups.
* **Attention to Detail:** excellent accuracy and the ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* **Soft Skills:** communicates effectively with customers by email and in person to answer questions and lead conversations, then translates those conversations into clear action plans.

**Additional Information**
==========================

* This position may require occasional travel to customer sites.
This role involves working closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful data migration and reconciliation.  
* 

The salary range in United States of America for this position is 88,000\.00 to 111,000\.00 USD Annual.  

  

For sales roles, this range includes the commission target. For non\-sales roles, this is a base salary only range; additional bonus eligibility may apply.  



  

Your specific offer within this range will be determined by your skills, experience, and qualifications.  



  

We are committed to pay transparency and fair compensation practices. If you have questions about our compensation approach, please don't hesitate to ask during the interview process.  

  



  

  

  

**Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.  



  

Learn more about our high\-energy, high\-performance global team: Work With Us


insightsoftware About Us: Hear From Our Team  



  

Background checks are required for employment with insightsoftware, where permitted by country, state/province.  



  

At insightsoftware, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Lead License Renewal Implementation Professional 1 – Nuclear
jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

This role offers a hybrid work arrangement. You'll spend three days a week in the office, giving you the flexibility to work remotely for two days.

  

As a key Associate in the Nuclear Power Group (NPG), you will have the opportunity to aid, participate and coordinate engineers and other professionals involved in support of License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) license extension, and post\-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet.  

  

  



S\&L is seeking an experienced License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) professional to support license extension and post\-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet. This role focuses on turning LR/SLR commitments and aging management program (AMP) requirements into practical, field\-executable inspection and implementation plans. It can also include performing visual inspections (e.g., VT\-1/VT\-2 or similar).


The ideal candidate brings experience with LR/SLR application and implementation and an optional combination of nuclear engineering programs, field trade experience (e.g., operations or maintenance), work management/scheduling, NRC submittals and/or inspections, and can bridge between technical aging management requirements, work management systems, and field execution.

  



**Key Responsibilities**

**License renewal \& aging management implementation**

* Support LR/SLR implementation activities such as procedure changes, preventive maintenance (PM) basis and frequency development, work order (WO) development and review, and nuclear program basis document updates.
* Roadmap required inspections and aging management activities to comply with NRC regulations, LR/SLR commitments, and applicable AMPs.
* Define and help maintain sample populations and inspection scopes (e.g., one\-time inspections, selective leaching, tank inspections) and ensure results are traceable to LR/SLR commitments and program requirements.

**Work Management \& Coordination Responsibilities**

* Use work management and planning systems (e.g., WOs, PMs, work items) to identify and capture LR/SLR opportunities in both online and outage scopes.
* Screen and analyze large WO and PM lists (often thousands of line items) to identify high\-value inspection opportunities based on system, component, material, and environment.
* Coordinate with schedulers, planners, and field organizations to embed aging management needs into realistic work sequences and outage plans.

**Engineering basis, documentation \& configuration control**

* Develop and maintain engineering program basis documentation, including AMP basis, PM basis, and supporting technical justifications.
* Perform data validation, engineering change tracking, and configuration control for LR/SLR\-related documents and commitments.
* Support NRC commitment tracking and closure, including preparing or reviewing technical responses, inspection packages, and closure documentation.

**Stakeholder engagement \& SME coordination**

* Interact with clients and NRC in a technical expert role, clearly explaining aging management strategies, inspection plans, and results.
* Work closely with mechanical, electrical, and structural SMEs, program owners, and field leads to refine scopes, aging mechanisms, and documentation expectations.

**Regulatory awareness \& operating experience**

* Maintain awareness of changes in LR/SLR and aging management regulations, guidance, and industry operating experience.
* Incorporate relevant NUREGs, NEI guidance, and industry OE into program basis documents, implementation strategies, and inspection plans.


Qualifications:
**We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.** **Essential Skills**

* An associate’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 10 or more years of experience in the design and analysis of nuclear, industrial, or DOE facilities.
* Proven experience managing and/or participating in multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Experience in managing medium\-to\-large critical projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience in providing guidance, mentoring, and training to staff engineers
* Licensed Operator for a Utility
* Experience delivering accurate, high\-quality technical documentation in a highly regulated environment (nuclear, DOE, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with engineering documentation systems, nuclear QA/QC protocols, and configuration management processes.
* Strong systems thinking skills, with the ability to balance innovation with compliance, safety, and traceability.
* Demonstrated ability to work with work management systems (e.g., work orders, PMs, planning tools) and to align technical requirements with implementable work packages and schedules.
* Proven capability to collaborate with SMEs and field organizations, using drawings, histories, prior WOs, and data to converge on practical implementation solutions.

**Preferred Experience**

**License renewal, SLR, and aging management**

* Prior involvement in license renewal, subsequent license renewal, or nuclear aging management programs, including development or implementation of AMPs, one\-time inspections, or selective leaching programs.
* Experience with NRC, INPO, or DOE regulations, and participation in NRC audits or inspections (e.g., Inspection Procedure 71003 or similar).
* Familiarity with key nuclear industry LR/SLR documents such as NUREG‑1800, NUREG‑1801, NEI 95‑10, NUREG‑2191, NUREG‑2192, NUREG‑2221, NEI 17‑01, and/or NUREG‑1555\.

**Background experience**

* Several years in a nuclear work management / outage or online planning, system engineering, or maintenance engineering role, preferably with exposure to LR/SLR implementation or aging management programs.
* Prior hands\-on or close\-support experience with plant modification or maintenance on mechanical systems (e.g., as a maintenance engineer, system engineer, field engineer, NDE/inspection engineer, or craft/trades lead) in a nuclear or similarly regulated environment.
* Experience working in cross\-functional project teams (engineering, programs, planning, field, and external consultants) to deliver complex, multi\-outage implementation scopes.

We have an exciting ***Sr Clinical Systems Validation Specialist*** opportunity for an experienced professional to join our team at Pediatrix Medical Group. We are a national organization, and one of the nation’s largest providers of prenatal, neonatal and pediatric services.  

Talented business professionals from diverse backgrounds choose Pediatrix because we are an exciting and innovative company that focuses on a team approach to improve the lives of patients everywhere. Responsibilities:

The ***Sr Clinical Systems Validation Specialist*** will facilitate and support development, testing, and education for the clinical information systems. This position will serve as a technical resource for these projects. Consult clinical personnel as needed regarding clinical issues related to Clinical Information Systems. Responsible for developing, implementing and maintaining test scripts that ensure exhaustive testing of clinical information systems to ensure compliance with system specifications.  

* Tests and evaluates all new versions of the Clinical Information Systems before implementation at beta sites. Follow testing plan as designed.
* Interpret user problems and suggest appropriate system change proposals to correct issues and to enhance system functionality and performance.
* Executes functional, application, regression, and performance tests for new version releases.

Review and update all Q/A items in JIRA related to production open, current build and specific projects.

Provides prompt, courteous, professional, and accurate information in all communications in dealing with physicians and other departments.

jobs.description:
Description:

\*\*Hybrid/Remote Position; must be in one of the following markets: West Palm Beach, Broward County, Boca Raton or Boynton Beach\*\*

**ABOUT PEOPLEONE HEALTH:**


PeopleOne Health is one of the fastest\-growing providers of value\-based primary care and has earned the best\-in\-class member satisfaction scores. We deliver exceptional healthcare that reduces costs and significantly improves health outcomes by focusing on preventive care, behavior change, and keeping people healthier. The key to our successful culture is living our motto: care for yourself; care for each other; care for our members.

**JOB SUMMARY:**


The Clinical Training Specialist is responsible for the development, coordination, and delivery of clinical training programs across new and existing health center locations. This position plays a critical role in ensuring clinical team members—including Medical Assistants, Providers, and other care team members—are trained in accordance with organizational standards, protocols, and workflows. The Specialist supports new hire onboarding, conducts competency assessments, and provides ongoing education and remediation to promote clinical quality, patient safety, and team performance.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


This position provides supervision to others: No

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Deliver structured orientation programs for Medical Assistants, clinical staff, and Providers.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual training for new clinic openings, including workflow simulation and go\-live support.
* Develop and update training materials, job aids, checklists, and policy\-based education tools.
* Collaborate with Area Managers, Clinical Leaders, and Operations to assess training needs.
* Facilitate mock clinics, hands\-on skills training, and real\-time coaching during and after new health center go\-live.
* Conduct chart audits and clinical quality checks to identify trends and provide targeted remediation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for EMR workflows, clinical processes, documentation, and best practices.
* Track training participation and competency validation in collaboration with the Training Coordinator.
* Stay current with clinical practice guidelines, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements.

**Other Duties:**

* Participate in the creation and execution of clinical onboarding plans for new hires.
* Support training initiatives related to quality improvement, patient experience, and EMR changes.
* Provide peer coaching, mentorship, and support to new or developing clinical team members.
* Assist in the development and implementation of training strategies for enterprise initiatives.
* Travel to health center locations as needed (estimated 50% \- 75%). May require an irregular schedule that changes weekly and monthly based on travel needs. May be expected to work some weekends and an occasional holiday.


Requirements:
**SKILLS \& ABILITIES:**

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for diverse adult learning styles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to assess training needs, identify skill gaps, and provide constructive feedback.
* Skilled in EMR workflows, clinical documentation, and chart auditing.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (docs, sheets, slides) and familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities across various locations.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to build positive working relationships with clinical and operational teams.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS \& CLEARANCES:**

* Required: Associate’s Degree in Nursing or allied health profession (e.g., MA, RT, LPN, RN).
* Current BLS/AED Certification
* Child Clearance \- Act 33
* Criminal Clearance \- Act 38
* FBI Clearance \- Act 73

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Required: Minimum 3 years of experience in a clinical role in primary care, urgent care, or similar outpatient setting.
* Required: Minimum 1 – 3 years experience in formal training delivery.
* Preferred: Experience in training program development or clinical education.
* Preferred: Familiarity with electronic health records (e.g., eClinicalWorks).

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

*(The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the position’s essential functions.)*

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and move freely throughout clinical environments.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds (training equipment, materials).
* Ability to travel between clinic sites, including overnight stays.

* The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls.
* Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

jobs.title: Clinical Systems Specialist, Praxis Health
jobs.description:
We're looking for a **Clinical Systems Specialist** to handle the day to day technical and operational work that keeps the technology across Praxis Health clinics running for providers and clinic staff, the EHR and the systems around it: user account provisioning, EPCS, provider schedule updates, and troubleshooting. This is hands on, execution focused work, not project management or training.



The role also owns day to day coordination of the Oracle relationship as it relates to new products, system updates, and Service Request (SR) creation and management. This role is responsible for managing the operational coordination required to support the Oracle relationship, ensuring smooth, effective interaction and alignment with strategic initiatives.



The role reports to the Clinical Systems Manager and coordinates with Directors of Operations and RLCMs when an issue affects a specific clinic or provider, and works closely with Operations to define and maintain clinical workflows and workflow changes driven by Oracle updates.


**Location \& Schedule**


* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
* **Location:** Remote for Oregon and Washington residents only


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts across clinical systems in line with onboarding, role change, and offboarding requests.
* Manage Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances (EPCS) enrollment, identity proofing coordination, and ongoing account maintenance for providers.
* Process and maintain provider schedule updates in the relevant clinical systems.
* Provide initial troubleshooting support for clinic staff and providers on account access, system errors, and basic system functionality; escalate issues beyond this scope to the appropriate technical owner.
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact with Oracle for new products, system updates, and Service Request (SR) creation and management; escalate strategic or contractual matters to the Director of Digital Transformation.
* Work with Operations to define and maintain clinical workflows and workflow changes driven by Oracle system updates.
* Partner with the Clinical Systems Training Specialists to flag workflow and technology changes that require staff education or training, so updates are communicated and adopted smoothly.
* Support change management for clinical systems initiatives and ensure changes are implemented in line with relevant Praxis Health policies and procedures.
* Champion innovative uses of technology that advance Praxis Health's strategic goals, looking beyond day\-to\-day maintenance to how clinical systems can move the organization forward.
* Maintain accurate records of account and access changes for audit and compliance purposes.
* Flag recurring issues or patterns to the Clinical Systems Manager rather than solving the same problem repeatedly in isolation.
* Support go\-live and cutover activities for the Oracle Health EHR implementation as needed, including account setup and access verification ahead of go\-live.
* Provide provisioning, troubleshooting, and workflow support across the full clinic technology stack, including the EHR, patient registration, document management, and bolt\-on vendor platforms, not the EHR alone.
* Support evaluation, rollout, and troubleshooting of AI\-enabled clinic tools such as ambient documentation and AI scribes as they are adopted.


**What You Bring:**


* Clinical background (nursing, allied health, or clinical operations) or a degree/certification in clinical informatics, health informatics, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of clinical workflows and how they translate into system requirements, configuration, and downstream impact on clinical staff and providers.
* Able to bridge clinical and technical perspectives, translating clinical needs into system changes, and system or workflow changes into plain terms for clinical staff.
* Comfortable with detail\-heavy, process\-driven work where accuracy and compliance matter.
* Curious and forward\-looking about technology; interested in more than keeping systems running, and in finding better ways to support Praxis Health's goals.
* Clear, patient communication style for working directly with clinical staff and providers who may not be technical.
* Experience working directly with an EHR vendor on support tickets, system updates, or product rollouts.
* Able to troubleshoot common clinical system and access issues and know when to escalate rather than guess.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with EHR or clinical system administration, including user account management and access provisioning.
* Familiarity with EPCS requirements and identity proofing processes.
* Familiarity with adjacent front\-office and revenue cycle processes such as patient registration, inbound document management, and basic billing/coding concepts.
* Exposure to AI tools in a healthcare setting; experience with AI scribes or ambient documentation a plus.


**About Our Company**



Praxis Health is a family of medical groups providing high\-quality healthcare throughout the state of Oregon. Our community\-based clinics are the DNA of our business, providing better medicine, advocacy for our patients, and a satisfying and collaborative culture for our providers and staff. The Praxis family approach is dynamically different from other healthcare companies in Oregon. We are not "big box" health care, but rather a company of small groups and clinics, of nimble micro\-cultures that can quickly adapt to industry changes, as well as patient needs. We have been serving communities across the beautiful and adventurous state of Oregon for over 50 years! And we are pioneers and thought leaders in the industry. Our commitment to innovative and operational excellence has allowed us to create healthcare solutions that are both cost\-efficient and cutting edge. Come see how healthcare is done right!


**General Physical Requirements**



Manual dexterity for office machine operation including computer and calculator; stooping, bending to handle files and supplies, mobility to complete errands for deliveries, or sitting for extended periods of time. The employee must regularly lift and /or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Stress can be triggered by multiple staff demands and deadlines.
